### Doorstone Seal - Foundation, Settlement
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 1 CP
Touch a door, gate, hatch, window, tunnel mouth, coffin, jar, chest, or similar opening set into a solid frame.
Earth pressure settles around it.
For the duration:
the opening cannot be opened by ordinary Strength checks unless the creature succeeds on a Strength check against your Earth Save DC;
creatures have Disadvantage on Dexterity checks made to pick or manipulate mundane locks on it;
if the opening is forced, broken, or magically bypassed, you know the seal was broken if you are within 1 mile and on the same plane.
Doorstone Seal does not prevent teleportation, planar travel, gaseous movement, incorporeal passage, or a creature already inside from breaking the object unless a feature says otherwise.

Prerequisite: CL 15+
When a creature within 30 feet of you would drop to 0 Hit Points while touching a solid surface, use your Reaction and expend 5 CP.
The creature drops to 1 Hit Point instead and is immediately moved up to 10 feet along the surface without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
The place where it would have fallen becomes a Foundation Space until the end of your next turn.

Prerequisite: Buried Foundation Remembers, CL 15+

Trigger: A creature you can perceive within 120 feet moves at least 30 feet in one turn, teleports, Dashes, or crosses three or more of your Foundation Spaces

### The World Rests on My Palm
“The immortal lowered one hand. The army did not fall. It simply discovered what it had always been standing on.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Bearing Ground, hidden earth-root scripture
Action Type: Action
Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on a point on the ground you can perceive or have ritually marked
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per month or once per major story arc, as determined by the GM
You claim the burden of a battlefield, valley, mountain pass, city gate, sect courtyard, mine, tomb complex, or other grounded region.
Choose one principle when you activate this inheritance.
#### Nothing Unmoored May Rule
Creatures hostile to you cannot teleport into, teleport out of, burrow through, phase through, or use planar movement through the area unless they succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Earth Save DC.
On a success, the movement works, but the creature gains one Burden Mark and takes 6d10 Force damage as the world makes it pay the weight of departure.
This does not block deity-scale movement, artifact-scale movement, or GM-declared story-scale passage.
#### The Ground Bears the Innocent
Choose any number of creatures you can name, see, or ritually identify as protected.
While a protected creature touches ground in the area:
it has Advantage on death saving throws;
it cannot be moved against its will by ordinary forced movement;
the first time each minute it would take damage, reduce that damage by 10d10;
if it would be buried, trapped, crushed, or fall into a fissure caused by terrain, move it to the nearest safe ground you choose within 60 feet.
#### The Burden Returns to the Violent
The first time each round that a hostile creature in the area deals damage, forces movement, destroys terrain, collapses a structure, or kills a creature, it gains one Burden Mark.
When you spend that mark, add 5d10 Bludgeoning damage or 5d10 Force damage to the Earth Response.
If the creature is already marked, it instead makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone, its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, and it cannot teleport until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
The World Rests on My Palm does not create permanent political ownership, legal title, or divine authority over the region.
It makes the region briefly answer your Dao of foundation and burden.
